The page gives a cost per kilometer of 3.5 to 4.5 million dollars. The wiki figure of 3 to 4 billion dollars is on the Energy Base page. That page was run through scripts/fetch.py (curl, TLS impersonation and the Chrome route) and all three failed on an access block, and it has no archived copy. The sheet cell stays blank.

The Gazprom annual report for 2022, read through the July 2023 archived copy, has only a pipeline map with the name Pisarevka on it. It does not describe this pipeline or give a status. The existing refs on the sheet stay. An Interfax article of 2023 describes the Western route from Pisarevka to Anapa, 880.6 km, as part of the Southern Corridor, and says new sections of Pochinki to Anapa were commissioned.
